jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer. Data, Cloud (AWS), Software
jobs.descriptionText:
About Tone Singleton
Tone Singleton is a technology company building software products across multiple domains, from CRM systems for healthcare clients to mobile learning applications for Mandarin Chinese learners. We operate as a lean engineering team that owns its infrastructure end to end, from AWS CDK stacks to end-user interfaces.
The Role
We're looking for a versatile full-stack engineer to join our small team (currently 3 developers). You'll work across the entire product lifecycle: designing data models, building backend services, crafting frontends, configuring CI/CD, managing infrastructure, and shipping features to production.
What You'll Work On
This isn't a role where you write React components all day. You'll set up Docker containers one morning and design a Microsoft Graph API integration the next.
CRM systems : Vendor and custom, with extensions (PHP/TypeScript).
Websites : Next.js + Tailwind CSS deployed on AWS Amplify. Payload CMS for content management. Storybook for component documentation. SEO and analytics.
Mobile applications : React Native apps. SQLite-based offline-first architecture with Drizzle ORM. iOS deployment via Fastlane.
Developer tooling : Projen-based project scaffolding library that generates standardised TypeScript packages, CDK constructs, Next.js apps, Payload CMS setups, and React Native projects.
Infrastructure : AWS CDK v2 stacks managing multi-account environments, Aurora Serverless PostgreSQL, CloudFront CDN, Route 53, SES email, and Amplify deployments. On-premises VM management with ESXi, Docker, NGINX (SWAG), and Portainer.
Day-to-Day Responsibilities
Design and implement features end-to-end (API → database → UI)
Set up and maintain CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions)
Configure production environments including Docker containers, DNS records, and SSL
Write and review pull requests in a trunk-based development workflow (feature branches → develop → main)
Manage dependency updates and security patches
Troubleshoot production issues (connection failures, container lifecycle, build performance)
Build reusable libraries and abstractions (ORM clients, type packages, CDK constructs)
OLTP and OLAP data modeling
Must-Have
Strong TypeScript proficiency across Node.js and browser/React environments
Good Python proficiency with the ecosystem (uv, Pydantic, ruff, etc)
Experience with Next.js (App Router, server components, middleware)
Comfortable with Docker, Linux server administration, and networking fundamentals (DNS, reverse proxies, SSL)
AWS experience. At minimum: Amplify, S3, CloudFront, RDS/Aurora, SES. CDK knowledge is a strong plus.
GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline authoring
Ability to work independently, create well-scoped issues, and drive features to completion without hand-holding
Conventional commits and clean PR hygiene
Nice-to-Have
React Native/mobile
PHP
Microsoft Azure AD / Graph API / SCIM
Projen or JSII
Payload CMS or similar headless CMS
Storybook and component-driven development
AWS CDK v2 with multi-account, multi-environment patterns
SQLite / Drizzle ORM
VMware ESXi / on-premise infrastructure management
What We Value
Ownership: you create the issue, implement the feature, deploy it, and verify it works in production.
Perfectionism : we don't see it as a flaw and prefer slower but better.
Breadth : the team is small. You'll touch PHP, TypeScript, Python, Docker, AWS, NGINX, and more within any given month. Yes, unfortunately, this means occasional context-switching that we're trying to minimise as much as possible, and you'll be part of it.
Clear communication : issues are well-described with context. PRs have descriptive titles. Questions get asked early, not after a week of going in the wrong direction.
How We Work
Small team (you + 3 engineers), flat hierarchy
GitHub-centric: issues with milestones, project boards, typed issues (Bug/Task), Dependabot for automated updates
Projen manages project configuration — no manual package.json edits
Conventional commits enforced via Husky/commitlint
We use AI-assisted development tooling (Kiro) and are building autonomous agent infrastructure (Bedrock AgentCore)
You'll be given a monthly AI tokens allowance
You'll be given a paid AWS SkillBuilder subscription and your AWS certification exams expenses will be covered
Note: Bonus points if you link a GitHub profile that shows you shipping real software across multiple technologies.

jobs.title: Founding Engineer (AI Router Product)
jobs.descriptionText:
We're a Registered Anthropic Partner and an Official Advanced Tier AWS Partner, currently serving 100+ enterprises and startups across the US, EU, and other Tier 1 markets.
We're starting a new product, Tokensaver : unified access to AI models for companies that use AI heavily, with the explicit goal of cutting their AI bill. You'd be the first engineer on it, building from scratch.
We are looking for a Founding AI Engineer who will build the "Tokensaver" product from scratch.
AI Router technology. This is the core of the product, so it should be the part you're most curious about. We expect candidate to have genuine interest in AI Router technology: model selection, routing logic, caching, fallbacks, and the cost/quality tradeoffs behind each.
What we expect:
3+ years of practical software engineering experience
You build with AI agents daily and use latest AI coding approaches in your daily workflow
Tech stack: Node.js, TypeScript, Next.js, PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, basic knowledge of Go or Rust is a plus
Hands-on experience with LLM APIs, agentic workflows, RAG, embeddings, structured outputs, prompt design, and where models break down
Experience building or integrating MCP servers, APIs, connectors, and components
Product-oriented thinking, understanding what to build - product judgment about what to ship and what to deliberately leave out
Genuine interest in AI Router technology
What we offer and why it's great opportunity:
Founding ownership. You're the founding engineering hire for Tokensaver product - you choose the architecture, the stack and decision on how to build.
Competetive base salary & equity compensation from day 1.
Clear career growth. There is a clear path to becoming the technical leader of Tokensaver product and building the engineering team around you.
Work on technology that is just being invented right now. AI routing and multi-model infrastructure are still at a very early stage, with best practices being defined in real time. You’ll work on intelligent model selection, caching, fallbacks, observability, and cost/quality/latency optimization at the frontier of modern AI infrastructure.
Distribution & real Credibility behind the company from day one. We're a Registered Anthropic Partner and an Official Advanced Tier AWS Partner. Our existing business already serves 100+ companies across the US, Europe, and other Tier 1 markets, giving Tokensaver a strong base for early users, feedback, and distribution.
To apply, please answer 2 questions:
1) How do you use AI tools in your daily work? Be specific - which AI tools, for which parts of the job.
2) Our goal is to build an AI Router Technology - unified access to AI models that cuts costs for businesses already spending heavily on AI. How would you approach building this from scratch?

jobs.title: Full-Stack Next.js Developer — розробка сайту-каталогу освітлення
jobs.descriptionText:

Проєкт — не простий лендинг і не сайт на готовій CMS. Це повноцінний каталог продукції з великою кількістю характеристик, модифікацій, фотографій, технічної документації та власною адміністративною частиною.

TypeScript
PostgreSQL
NeonDB

Категорія → тип світильника → серія → модифікації → конкретний артикул.
Картка конкретного товару повинна містити фотографії, артикул, потужність, світловий потік, колірну температуру, CRI, кут світла, IP, колір/RAL, габарити, тип монтажу, керування/DALI, креслення, IES/LDT, PDF-документацію, інструкції, аксесуари та інші модифікації серії.

Сайт повинен бути швидким, адаптивним, SEO-friendly та нормально працювати з великою кількістю товарів і фільтрів.

Чи робили ви каталоги/e-commerce із великою кількістю товарів та характеристик?
Покажіть 2–3 реально працюючі проєкти , які ви особисто розробляли. Вкажіть, яку саме частину робили ви.
Чи працювали з PostgreSQL / NeonDB ?
Чи створювали власні адмінпанелі ?
Орієнтовно вкажіть вашу вартість роботи / ставку та доступність .
Важливо: нас цікавить розробник для нормальної довгострокової співпраці, а не просто виконання окремої сторінки.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer ( Quality and AI)
jobs.descriptionText:
We need a senior engineer who owns the question of whether our AI features actually work. About 70 percent of the job is quality and evaluation in agent-based development: harnesses, datasets, regression gates, and the standards around them. The other 30 percent is raising the quality of everyone else’s product work. You review code across the Node, React, and React Native apps, coach engineers on resilient design, and shape features before they are built. You write production code too, but to keep your judgment current, not as your primary output.
That stack is Node services, React and React Native front ends, PostgreSQL, and AWS. Playwright for web, Maestro for mobile, GitHub Actions for CI.
If you want a pure test automation role, this is not it. If you want to be the person who defines what good means on a team building with coding agents, and who has the credibility to hold that line in review, keep reading.
What you will own
Quality and evals, about 70 percent of the work
Eval harnesses, golden datasets, and scoring for production agentic workflows.
Regression gates in CI. Nothing merges without an eval verdict.
The Playwright web and Maestro mobile end-to-end suites. Fast, and honest about failures.
Engineering standards: code review practice, architectural patterns, targeted refactors.
Production instrumentation for AI features, and the loop that turns real failures into new eval cases.
Product craft and resilience, about 30 percent of the work
Code review across the Node, React, and React Native codebases. Not rubber stamps. Specific feedback that leaves the author better than you found them.
Coaching on resilient design: error handling, retries and idempotency, failure isolation, and the tests that prove the behavior.
Quality designed into features up front. You are in feature design early, not reviewing at the end.
Light hands-on contribution to production code, enough to keep your review credibility and your context current.
Game day. When something breaks on a Saturday, you are in the troubleshooting: reading traces, reproducing the failure, and driving it down.
Requirements
5+ years building and operating production web software.
Strong JavaScript and TypeScript. You know the runtime, not just the framework.
Node and React in production. React Native shipped to the app stores is a strong plus.
PostgreSQL: schema design for read patterns, index design, query plans, migration under load.
AWS in production: ECS or Lambda, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch, IAM. You can read the bill.
Playwright or equivalent, used on a suite you personally had to keep green.
CI/CD work in GitHub Actions, including making a slow pipeline fast.
A track record of raising code quality: reviews, architectural patterns, refactors that landed.
You have reviewed and mentored other engineers on production code. You can name specific practices that spread across a team because of you.
Strong asynchronous written communication.
AI engineering and evaluation
A hard requirement, not a preference. Expect detailed questions.
Daily work with frontier models and agentic coding tools such as Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor.
Evaluations you built yourself for an LLM or agent system. What you scored, how you scored it, and what you did when the score moved.
Dataset construction. You can explain how you sourced cases, handled labeling, and kept the set from going stale.
Judgment about failure modes. You can name the ways an agentic workflow breaks that a unit test will never catch.
A repeatable method for giving agents context: instruction files, tool definitions, MCP servers, subagent roles.
Cost awareness. You track token spend and wall-clock time per unit of shipped work.
Nice to have: eval platforms such as LangSmith, Braintrust, or Langfuse; agent frameworks and SDKs; internal tooling and MCP servers; mobile end-to-end testing; multi-tenant SaaS; sports, scheduling, or field-services domains

jobs.title: Senior Frontend Developer
jobs.descriptionText:
